ns2:course.label: Banking and Financial Regulation
ns2:course.description: Survey of the structure, functions, regulation, and risk management activities of banks and nonbank financial institutions; central banking and monetary policy effects on financial institutions. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: FIN 300 or consent of instructor.
